item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
enjoy if you like or don't if you don't

option a

it's a nice vignette, though i didn't really understand the presence of the zork reference. the idea of a bleached 173 slowly encasing itself in a mound of fecal waste and blood is both piteous and a nice bit of - body horror, i guess? the way its attitude towards humanity and observers in general being narcissistic and ego-maniacal is not the greatest leap in logic but it's executed really well and it ties together the whole story with it killing itself at the end.

overall a fun bit of short fiction warranting quality kudos
